mapper.select:
select * from (
select 'audit' as type, '1' as bizType, a.apply_id as bizId, a.apply_no as bizNo, a.enterprise_id as enterpriseId, e.enterprise_name as enterpriseName, a.apply_status as status, a.buyer_name as buyerName, a.create_time as createTime, null as nextQueryTime, 'apply' as statusKind from t_invoice_apply a left join t_enterprise e on e.enterprise_id = a.enterprise_id where a.del_flag = '0' and a.apply_status in ('0', '1') and ifnull((select ar.audit_result from t_audit_record ar where ar.biz_type = '2' and ar.biz_id = a.apply_id order by ar.audit_time desc, ar.audit_record_id desc limit 1), '') != '2' union all
select 'audit' as type, '2' as bizType, r.red_apply_id as bizId, r.red_apply_no as bizNo, o.enterprise_id as enterpriseId, e.enterprise_name as enterpriseName, r.red_status as status, o.buyer_name as buyerName, r.create_time as createTime, r.confirm_expire_time as nextQueryTime, 'red' as statusKind from t_red_apply r left join t_invoice o on o.invoice_id = r.original_invoice_id left join t_enterprise e on e.enterprise_id = o.enterprise_id where r.del_flag = '0' and r.red_status in ('0', '2') and ifnull((select ar.audit_result from t_audit_record ar where ar.biz_type = '3' and ar.biz_id = r.red_apply_id order by ar.audit_time desc, ar.audit_record_id desc limit 1), '') != '2' union all
select 'material' as type, '1' as bizType, a.apply_id as bizId, a.apply_no as bizNo, a.enterprise_id as enterpriseId, e.enterprise_name as enterpriseName, a.apply_status as status, a.buyer_name as buyerName, a.create_time as createTime, null as nextQueryTime, 'apply' as statusKind from t_invoice_apply a left join t_enterprise e on e.enterprise_id = a.enterprise_id where a.del_flag = '0' and a.apply_status not in ('5', '6', '7') and (select ar.audit_result from t_audit_record ar where ar.biz_type = '2' and ar.biz_id = a.apply_id order by ar.audit_time desc, ar.audit_record_id desc limit 1) = '2' union all
select 'material' as type, '2' as bizType, r.red_apply_id as bizId, r.red_apply_no as bizNo, o.enterprise_id as enterpriseId, e.enterprise_name as enterpriseName, r.red_status as status, o.buyer_name as buyerName, r.create_time as createTime, null as nextQueryTime, 'red' as statusKind from t_red_apply r left join t_invoice o on o.invoice_id = r.original_invoice_id left join t_enterprise e on e.enterprise_id = o.enterprise_id where r.del_flag = '0' and r.red_status not in ('5', '6', '7') and (select ar.audit_result from t_audit_record ar where ar.biz_type = '3' and ar.biz_id = r.red_apply_id order by ar.audit_time desc, ar.audit_record_id desc limit 1) = '2' union all
select 'user' as type, t.biz_type as bizType, t.biz_id as bizId, t.task_no as bizNo, ifnull(a.enterprise_id, o.enterprise_id) as enterpriseId, e.enterprise_name as enterpriseName, t.task_status as status, ifnull(a.buyer_name, o.buyer_name) as buyerName, t.create_time as createTime, t.next_query_time as nextQueryTime, 'rpa' as statusKind from t_rpa_task t left join t_invoice_apply a on a.apply_id = t.biz_id and t.biz_type = '1' left join t_red_apply r on r.red_apply_id = t.biz_id and t.biz_type = '2' left join t_invoice o on o.invoice_id = r.original_invoice_id left join t_enterprise e on e.enterprise_id = ifnull(a.enterprise_id, o.enterprise_id) where t.task_status = '1' union all
select 'user' as type, v.biz_type as bizType, v.biz_id as bizId, ifnull(a.apply_no, r.red_apply_no) as bizNo, ifnull(a.enterprise_id, o.enterprise_id) as enterpriseId, e.enterprise_name as enterpriseName, v.verify_status as status, ifnull(a.buyer_name, o.buyer_name) as buyerName, v.create_time as createTime, v.expire_time as nextQueryTime, 'verify' as statusKind from t_tax_verify v left join t_invoice_apply a on a.apply_id = v.biz_id and v.biz_type = '1' left join t_red_apply r on r.red_apply_id = v.biz_id and v.biz_type = '2' left join t_invoice o on o.invoice_id = r.original_invoice_id left join t_enterprise e on e.enterprise_id = ifnull(a.enterprise_id, o.enterprise_id) where v.verify_status in ('0', '1') union all
select 'unknown' as type, t.biz_type as bizType, t.biz_id as bizId, t.task_no as bizNo, ifnull(a.enterprise_id, o.enterprise_id) as enterpriseId, e.enterprise_name as enterpriseName, t.task_status as status, ifnull(a.buyer_name, o.buyer_name) as buyerName, t.create_time as createTime, t.next_query_time as nextQueryTime, 'rpa' as statusKind from t_rpa_task t left join t_invoice_apply a on a.apply_id = t.biz_id and t.biz_type = '1' left join t_red_apply r on r.red_apply_id = t.biz_id and t.biz_type = '2' left join t_invoice o on o.invoice_id = r.original_invoice_id left join t_enterprise e on e.enterprise_id = ifnull(a.enterprise_id, o.enterprise_id) where t.task_status = '3' union all
select 'unknown' as type, '1' as bizType, a.apply_id as bizId, a.apply_no as bizNo, a.enterprise_id as enterpriseId, e.enterprise_name as enterpriseName, a.apply_status as status, a.buyer_name as buyerName, a.create_time as createTime, null as nextQueryTime, 'apply' as statusKind from t_invoice_apply a left join t_enterprise e on e.enterprise_id = a.enterprise_id where a.del_flag = '0' and a.apply_status = '3' union all
select 'unknown' as type, '2' as bizType, r.red_apply_id as bizId, r.red_apply_no as bizNo, o.enterprise_id as enterpriseId, e.enterprise_name as enterpriseName, r.red_status as status, o.buyer_name as buyerName, r.create_time as createTime, null as nextQueryTime, 'red' as statusKind from t_red_apply r left join t_invoice o on o.invoice_id = r.original_invoice_id left join t_enterprise e on e.enterprise_id = o.enterprise_id where r.del_flag = '0' and r.red_status = '3' ) todo
and todo.type = #{q.type} and todo.status = #{q.status}
and (todo.bizNo like concat('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') or todo.enterpriseName like concat('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') or todo.buyerName like concat('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
and todo.createTime >= #{q.startTime} and todo.createTime <= #{q.endTime}
order by todo.createTime desc

select (select count(1) from t_invoice_apply a where a.del_flag = '0' and a.apply_status in ('0', '1') and ifnull((select ar.audit_result from t_audit_record ar where ar.biz_type = '2' and ar.biz_id = a.apply_id order by ar.audit_time desc, ar.audit_record_id desc limit 1), '') != '2') + (select count(1) from t_red_apply r where r.del_flag = '0' and r.red_status in ('0', '2') and ifnull((select ar.audit_result from t_audit_record ar where ar.biz_type = '3' and ar.biz_id = r.red_apply_id order by ar.audit_time desc, ar.audit_record_id desc limit 1), '') != '2')

select (select count(1) from t_invoice_apply a where a.del_flag = '0' and a.apply_status not in ('5', '6', '7') and (select ar.audit_result from t_audit_record ar where ar.biz_type = '2' and ar.biz_id = a.apply_id order by ar.audit_time desc, ar.audit_record_id desc limit 1) = '2') + (select count(1) from t_red_apply r where r.del_flag = '0' and r.red_status not in ('5', '6', '7') and (select ar.audit_result from t_audit_record ar where ar.biz_type = '3' and ar.biz_id = r.red_apply_id order by ar.audit_time desc, ar.audit_record_id desc limit 1) = '2')
select (select count(1) from t_rpa_task where task_status = '1') + (select count(1) from t_tax_verify where verify_status in ('0', '1'))

select (select count(1) from t_rpa_task where task_status = '3') + (select count(1) from t_invoice_apply where del_flag = '0' and apply_status = '3') + (select count(1) from t_red_apply where del_flag = '0' and red_status = '3')
